worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.summary: Scoop up near-freezing water and douse the target: it saps their power (Attack falls) and soaks them, leaving a wet patch where it lands. The glaze form freezes a slippery ring at the landing spot, but hits lighter and casts slower.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.use.1: Soak the target so later water and ice moves can exploit the wet state
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.use.2: Freeze a ring of ground to push a foe off their footing
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.descript: Deals about %1$s special damage on hit.

On hit the target's Attack falls %1$s stage(s) and it is soaked for about %2$s: while soaked it moves 10%% slower, and other water and ice moves can read the wet state. An already-soaked target is chilled harder, taking more damage and dropping one more Attack stage.
Range %1$s blocks, glob speed %2$s blocks/tick, trace radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.glaze.on: Currently glaze: freezes a slippery %1$s-block-radius ring at the landing spot for about %2$s, but hits lighter, has shorter range and casts slower.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.glaze.of: Currently no ice: a harder hit that reaches further and casts faster.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.growth.0: From level %1$s the douse rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.growth.1: From level %1$s the douse rises to %2$s power and the soak lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.chillingwater.preferen: On: freezes a slippery ring at the landing spot and soaks longer, but douse ×0.9, range −2, +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: no ice, a harder hit that reaches further and casts faster.
